curator_notes: Year set to 2026 based on the founder's '2026' activity statement; exact dates unknown. Two of five featured projects (SAMM, Auctopus) pitch nearly the same idea-to-concept pipeline — a sponsor-fit signal (brand/3D/video generation sponsors) rather than originality.
